description: 10-90 % rise time of 7-semitone linear saw glides read by librosa pYIN.
name: 61-glide

glides.rise: time between the first voiced frames above 10 % and 90 % of the step, in semitones over the start pitch
glides.signal: 0.5 * band-limited saw, harmonic h at 1/h below the Nyquist frequency of the top pitch; phase is the running sum of f / rate; pitch linear in semitones over the glide

recipe.note: the #61 method: frame 2048, hop 128, fmin 30 Hz; the issue states no fmax, so the #61 track ceiling of 400 Hz is used
recipe.tolerance: a rise is a whole number of hops (5.8 ms), so a row reproduces when it lies within one hop of the issue figure
